changes: When Keeta does not show the meal by name, the closest Keeta meals are offered; the user's pick is remembered per restaurant (on the phone only).
A required Keeta group with no matching row is asked about: the row to pick, and which HungerStation choice it names (or none).
HungerStation choices with no place in the Keeta meal can be left out after the user agrees.
After a Keeta tap, the group's 'تم' is re-read for up to ~2 s before stopping.
The HungerStation location prompt is also recognized by its window class, only while no known screen is readable.
HungerStation cart lines and the menu cart bar with a struck-through old price read the current price.
An optional HungerStation group whose limit exceeds its rows completes after the observed end of options.
A Keeta cart drawer left open on another restaurant (also after leaving an earlier review) is closed with Back.
Keeta 'اختياري' groups are left untouched; choice names differing only in sandwich spelling or the filler words تشيكن/دجاج match one requested choice.
A Keeta restaurant name followed by a space and a priced campaign ('… 13 ريال') matches the chain; districts and branches do not.
A combo title with the same words in another order (كومبو ↔ وجبة) matches the Keeta meal.
The HungerStation different-location prompt is detected from its fixed phrases before redaction and closed with Back.
HungerStation review on the S22: the tip sheet's scroller is skipped and the place-order button keeps the review recognized; up to 10 review scrolls.
HungerStation cart: wait for the drawn summary before proving it; the Compare tap re-reads a half-drawn cart.
HungerStation 'ordering for a different location?' prompt is closed with system Back only (no button on it is tapped).
Keeta cart closing with a savings section (delivery discount, or promoted-items discount) is read; the '70/0' note counter is accepted.
After the comparison, the cheaper app's prepared cart opens from 'أكمل الطلب في …'.
The stop reason is always shown in red.
Order total read past struck-through fees; Keeta launch advert closed; far-branch cart explained.
A later patch of a verified HungerStation or Keeta release runs on that release's profile.
Keeta names written differently match the requested item or restaurant; Terra can confirm a restaurant alias.
Configured meals: a stale or partial Keeta cart shows the clear-cart control; longer time windows for the meal proof.
A Compare tap reads the edited HungerStation cart, and a previous Keeta cart of matching rows is completed.
The 'I emptied the Keeta cart' confirmation shows again when the Keeta reason follows the HungerStation result.
Keeta 3.13.301 single-SKU sheets with an empty special-request section are accepted as plain products; a typed note, a second SKU or a price mismatch is still rejected.
The Add guard expects that one empty note field on such a sheet.
Everything from 1.3.22 is kept: the HungerStation total is shown even when Keeta stops.

limitations: Keeta products with real option groups are still added only for the verified cases; others stop before any add.
Multiple configured meals are still not run on a phone.
Not supported: a plain item in the same cart as a meal with options, two meals with the same name, quantity above one, a Keeta cart that already holds only some of the meals, and optional additions.
If the Keeta cart drawer scrolls with three or four meals, the comparison stops with a message; this has not been tried.
Verified on ALBAIK, KFC and Popeyes; meals with two same-named choice groups and meals whose Keeta name drops words are not supported.
privacy: No account data, addresses, tokens, private captures or signing material included.
